title: use for hot cider/punch
text: use for hot cider/punch. I bought this for entertaining at family/friends gatherings.  I have two.  One I use for coffee and this one I use for ONLY hot cider/punch.  It worked well and kept the spiced cider very hot all night.  I will post updates as it ages.  For now, it works great.
